decision_rule: If best and second-best targets are close, do not choose by raw score alone. Use global assignment, neighbor evidence, relation cues, and gold repeated patterns.

algorithms.name: global_sequence_assignment
algorithms.method: Viterbi dynamic programming over source_span_index and target_clause_index
algorithms.why: Prevents several adjacent source phrases from all selecting the same broad target.
constraints: one source can map to one primary target
target reuse allowed only for explains_line or parent diagnostic
split children may map to subclauses

algorithms.name: local_neighbor_reranking
algorithms.method: Use previous and next accepted links as anchors.
algorithms.why: The correct target often lies between two accepted neighbour targets.

algorithms.name: gold_pattern_reranker
algorithms.method: Match candidate to v3/v4 gold patterns such as crescent, Ganga, Ravana, worship-result.
algorithms.why: Repeated devotional and iconographic patterns should resolve ambiguity even with low surface overlap.

algorithms.name: span_granularity_penalty
algorithms.method: Penalize targets that contain multiple unrelated concepts if a shorter subspan exists.
algorithms.why: Ambiguous rows often choose a long commentary phrase that includes both correct and incorrect material.
